problem: More agents increase cost and conflict instead of helping.
principle: Parallelize independent deliverables only; preserve dependencies, validate evidence and bound concurrency/deadlines.
check: Do three agreeing agents prove a claim?
answer: No. Correlated errors and shared sources require independent verification.

procedures.state: Task state, tool trace and remaining budget.
procedures.failure: Latency adds up but no distributed merge race is introduced.
procedures.measure: Baseline success, latency and call cost.
procedures.case: Compute totals only after collecting quotations.

procedures.state: Assignments, sub-budgets, artifact schemas and sources.
procedures.failure: Resolve conflicting evidence from sources, not majority voting.
procedures.measure: Benefit versus duplicated search, merge cost and conflict rate.
procedures.case: Research markets independently with timestamped source-backed quotations.

procedures.state: DAG, node states, deadlines and cancellation.
procedures.failure: Cancel dependent work after required-node failure; await cleanup.
procedures.measure: Critical-path latency, peak concurrency and missing/duplicate nodes.
procedures.case: Fetch A/B concurrently; comparison C waits for both.

scope: The code implements bounded in-process read-only concurrency. Distributed supervision, persistent handoff and full DAG scheduling require the dedicated design mechanisms.
